title: Anwar’s Party Loses Key Politician as Reform Frustration Grows
title_cn: 随着改革受挫加剧，安瓦尔的政党失去了关键政治家
summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s People’s Justice Party lost a reformist politician to a three-month-old political movement led by former cabinet members, underscoring divisions as it struggles to rebuild support after a string of lackluster election results.
